items.title: Buddy Collette interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 13, 1999
items.q: In the reed section there was Jerome Richardson, Phil Woods, Pepper Adams, Eric Dolphy, I was there, on and on.

ctx.x: Yeah Clark and Snooky Young, Ernie Royal, Bernie Glow, trombones Britt Woodman, Butter Jackson — I can’t think of the other trombone player — but all the great guys. In the reed section there was Jerome Richardson, Phil Woods, Pepper Adams, Eric Dolphy, I was there, on and on.
